criteria.requirement: Add --params-json to real SQL2CSV. Accept a finite JSON object of scalar/null values, require exact agreement with named binds parsed by SQLAlchemy text(query), execute through connection.execute(statement,parameters) without string interpolation, eval or logging parameter values. Reject invalid JSON, nested values and missing/extra binds. Preserve the original exec_driver_sql path when absent, CSV headers/type output and query/file precedence. Ensure connection context and engine disposal execute on success, validation, query and output failures; all tests use only temporary SQLite, never network databases.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
